english.title: Keeper of dog fail to comply with notice to get dog microchipped within 21 days - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the keeper of a dog, namely **(..IDENTIFY DOG..), and having been served with a notice under regulation 12(a) of the Microchipping of Dogs (Wales) Regulations 2015 on **(..SPECIFY DATE NOTICE SERVED..) by **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), an authorised person under those regulations, failed to have that dog microchipped within 21 days
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(a) and 13(2)(e) of the Microchipping of Dogs (Wales) Regulations 2015.
